name: Okano Kana
source:
The middle daughter of 3 daughters in the Okano family.

She is an active (manly) girl and vice captain of the judo club. She may look like a girl, but she has a rough and violent personality that is not like a woman's.

She is a strong woman who never misses a single day of training. She also sometimes takes Ryouta by force to go jogging at night, a routine she does not miss even for a single day.

The only thing Ryouta can beat Kana at is video games. She takes it out on Ryouta when she loses.

After taking a bath, she always wears only panties and a neck towel.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/matty.html]official site[/url].
